title: chore(release): 6.0.0-beta.1 (algolia/react-instantsearch#2861)
explanation: The GitHub issue describes several improvements and bug fixes to the React-InstantSearch library, which is a positive sign of active development and progress on the project. The extensive list of changes, including migration to new React context API, fixes for GeoSearch, improvements to SSR handling, and removal of unused dependencies, indicates that the maintainers are actively addressing issues and enhancing the library's functionality.
